checks: Authenticated chat uses the API client, sends minimal navigation context, shows loading and Gemini attribution; chatting never navigates or dims the page.
Becoming a tutor has its own real profile tour; selection does not navigate until Start. A new chat clears stale tour completion and sends the completed guide as context.
Study conversation displays both turns, forwards recent context, and remains silent until the user requests audio.
Failure is explicit, manual tours remain usable, and retry reuses the same payload without duplicating the user message.
Clearing conversation cancels pending requests and ignores late responses even if a transport ignores abort.
Closing cancels requests; late replies cannot reopen or overwrite the assistant.
An accreditation/modal suspends the assistant, aborts pending work and never automatically reopens after the modal closes.
User and model messages render as plain text; unknown guide identifiers cannot become links or actions.
The chat fits 320/390/768/1440 px and remains readable in light, dark and Calm themes.
Changing account aborts pending responses, resets history and keeps message text out of local/session storage.
scope: Real React UI, AppRouter, profile tour and HTTP client. Synthetic account, app data, AI responses and audio. Separate live Gemini smoke test verifies the provider. No production writes.
